name: River's Edge Apple River Campground
note: Campground of the River's Edge tubing outfitter on the Apple River near Somerset/New Richmond: RV camping $15 per adult ($8 ages 6-12) plus $15/night for 30-amp electric - about $45 for two; full-hookup and seasonal sites too; rustic cabins. RoverPass booking. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: appleriver.com live with camping rates ($15/adult) and RoverPass booking; 30-amp electric $15/night extra (AWH 2026-10-02) - two adults with electric ~$45; Google 4.3 over 688 with phone (read 2026-10-02); Good Sam directory listing
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 45.1247,-92.6399: campground loops on open ground between WI-35/64 and a local road; the Apple River is north of the road and out of view - not waterfront
